channel.title: AI News Radar
channel.description: A curated 24-hour radar of AI news: official releases, new models and high-signal discussion.

item.title: Introducing GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra beats GPT-6 Astra by 5.2 points on Agents' Last Exam at under a third of the cost, while GPT-6.2 Sol trails it by just 0.5 points on FrontierCode 2.0 at roughly one-fifth the price. (OpenAI News)

item.title: Codex CLI 0.170.0
item.description: Codex CLI 0.170.0 adds GPT-6.2 Astra for hardest projects like implementing and testing changes across existing codebases, plus GPT-6.2 Sol for everyday coding and writing, with Pro $200 unlocking Sol's Ultrafast and Pro $500 both models. (OpenAI Codex Changelog)

item.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol now available
item.description: OpenAI's GPT-6.2 Astra and GPT-6.2 Sol are generally available in GitHub Copilot for agentic coding and code review, and in early testing both caught significantly more real code issues than earlier GPT-6 models while using fewer tokens. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Put Gemini to work for you
item.description: Tasks in Gemini is free in six countries—U.S., Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia and India—and a Gemini 4 Hydrogen demo used Personal Intelligence to recognize a 2019 Honda Odyssey and home address, booking Friday morning service in under five minutes. (Google AI Blog)

item.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion updates: more availability, benchmarks, and models
item.description: GitHub Copilot Fusion expands to github.com, Visual Studio and GitHub Mobile beta, and posts a 71.2% Terminal-Bench 4.1 solve rate, 5.4 points ahead of Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.2 at 57% and 88% lower cost respectively. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Anthropic launches beta linked billing on Claude platform, closing the ecosystem loop and opening OAuth billing tests for third-party apps
item.description: Anthropic launched a beta linked-billing feature on Claude and began OAuth billing tests for third-party apps, tying external calls to user accounts and billing to pave the way for plugin, tool and service commercialization. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Copilot Evals is now in public preview
item.description: GitHub Copilot Evals is in public preview for Individual, Business and Enterprise users, letting them build repeatable tests for skills, agents and MCP tools, rerun the same eval after changes to catch regressions, with an engine built on the local Vally tool. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Office roles reversed: Microsoft tucks Word and Excel inside Copilot, with AI as the face
item.description: At Ignite 2026 Microsoft repositioned Office around a new Copilot app that folds in Word, Excel and PowerPoint, letting users describe documents in natural language, open them beside the chat, and store them in OneDrive under enterprise compliance. (AIbase)

item.title: Copilot code review: Adaptive effort, secret detection, and more
item.description: GitHub Copilot code review's new Adaptive mode automatically picks Lite, Balanced or Max review depth based on pull request risk, while public previews add cross-repository context and exposed-secret detection before merges reach the main branch. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Free and open source breeds resentment? DeepSeek draws extreme backlash and complaints over long-context rate limiting alone
item.description: DeepSeek's rate limiting on some ultra-long-context features triggered app-store review bombing and extreme complaints, as long-form novel writing and heavy role-play sessions consume large amounts of tokens and strain compute, though the company says everyday queries are unaffected. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Copilot app, Microsoft Ignite releases
item.description: GitHub Copilot app's Azure DevOps integration is in public preview, letting users clone repositories, create branches, edit code and submit pull requests inside the app, while also supporting GitHub Enterprise Server and existing browser sign-in. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: 224B total parameters and 1M-token ultra-long context! Tencent Hunyuan makes a major open-source release of the Hy4 flash family, now fully available across its multi-platform ecosystem
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan open-sourced the three-version Hy4flash family, including Base, with 224B total parameters, only 12B activated per token, 1M-token context, and deployment on GitHub and Hugging Face. (AIbase)

item.title: MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash in GitHub Copilot
item.description: Microsoft AI's MAI Code 2 and MAI Code 2 Flash have landed in GitHub Copilot, extending the MAI-Code family from lightweight coding assistance to complex, agentic software engineering with vision support and usage-based billing. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Art students who once feared AI would take their jobs now lead a team producing 20 short dramas a month, surpassing 1 million in revenue in five months.
item.description: A digital-media art student who feared AI leads 20+ people producing 20-plus comic short dramas monthly, using 14 self-trained models and Kling, Jimeng to cut script breakdown from a week to a day and hit ¥1 million in five months. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Copilot CLI adds Microsoft Entra sign-in as a preview
item.description: GitHub Copilot CLI’s public preview adds Microsoft Entra sign-in for silent single sign-on to linked GitHub Enterprise Managed User accounts, optional Microsoft 365 Copilot license use, and requires version v1.0.113 or later. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Tesla's Two-Pronged Push: FSD Ad in Times Square, Grok Bot Lights Up Las Vegas Sphere
item.description: Tesla is running its first FSD ad on the Chase screen in New York’s Times Square through late November, claiming 7x human-driver safety, 15 billion cumulative miles and 1.74 million FSD subscriptions, alongside a Grok Bot Sphere display in Las Vegas. (AIbase)

item.title: GitHub Copilot in JetBrains, Ignite releases
item.description: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains now adds isolated cloud sandbox runs, remote access across VS Code and the Copilot app, on-device voice dictation, Browser Use controls, context shortcuts, historical diffs and chat reliability fixes, while support for 2025.2 has ended. (GitHub Changelog)

item.title: Tencent open-sources Hy4 flash: a 224B model lands on GitHub, free for anyone to download
item.description: Tencent Hunyuan open-sourced Hy4flash, a 224B-parameter model that activates only 12B parameters per token and supports a 1-million-token context, releasing it on GitHub alongside quantized Hy4flash-FP8 and Base versions. (AIbase)

item.title: Agents API by Recall.ai — Send your agent to meetings
item.description: Recall.ai's headline promises an Agents API that sends agents into meetings, yet the page body shows only a CAPTCHA security check, with no product features, parameters or data, leaving the announcement itself unreadable. (Product Hunt)

item.title: Track Copilot code review outcomes in Repository insights
item.description: GitHub's new Repository insights page, the first item in a repo's Insights tab, consolidates four summary signals showing whether Copilot code review feedback is adopted, human reviewers still request changes, and merges skip review. (GitHub Changelog)
